1.name: Aura of Resistance
1.description: An aura which greatly wards your group from the arcane, increasing their Magic, Cold, Fire, Corruption, and Holy Resistance by 2 (L1) to 30 (L60) and increases Spell Damage Reduction by 5%.

effects.display: 2–30% and increases Spell Reduction by 5% dmg (L1–L60)

1.valuesSummary: +2–30 Holy Resistance (L1–L60) · 2–30% and increases Spell Reduction by 5% dmg (L1–L60)

1.name: Magic Protection
1.description: Wards your target from the arcane, increasing their Magic Resistance by 5 for 1 hour.

1.name: Mind Exhaustion
1.description: Exhaust your target, slowing their Casting Speed by 10% for 1 minute.

1.name: Polar Align: North
1.description: Magically align yourself, orienting you toward the North Pole.

1.name: Shoot
1.description: Shoots your target with a bow. (requires bow & arrows)

1.name: Slam
1.description: Forcefully slam your target, dealing 100% Weapon Damage plus 1 (L1) to 20 (L60) Physical Damage, and increasing your Threat by 20 (L1) to 200 (L60). Has a chance to stun from behind the target.

1.name: Taunt
1.description: Taunt your target, causing them to focus their attacks on you. Triggers cooldown of Martial abilities.

1.name: Torment
1.description: Torments your target's mental state, causing 3 (L1) to 5 (L4) points of Magic Damage and decreasing their Intelligence, Wisdom, Charisma, and Mana Regeneration by 2.

2.name: Magic Break
2.description: Breaks your target's resistance to the arcane, decreasing their Magic Resistance by 1 (L1) to 4 (L8). This spell is unresistable if the target is not immune to magic or it can otherwise by landed normally.

3.name: Minor Spellshield
3.description: A magical shield encircles you, increasing your HP by 10, AC by 5, and Magic Resistance by 5.

3.name: Kick
3.description: Swiftly kick your target, interrupting their casting and preventing them from casting spells from the same school of magic for 4 seconds.

4.name: Spell Ward
4.description: Shield your target with a spell ward, absorbing 25 Spell Damage received for 15 seconds.

4.name: Weapon Shield
4.description: Activate to use your weapon to help shield attacks, reducing physical damage against you by 5%.

4.name: Arcane Aegis
4.description: Surround yourself with an arcane aegis, granting you immunity to spell damage for 15 seconds. This spell can be used while stunned, incapacitated, or feared. This spell inflicts Exhausted Soul upon expiration, preventing the application of immunity effects for 30 seconds.

5.name: Mesmerize
5.description: Mesmerizes your target, putting them to Sleep for 30 seconds. There is a very small chance that the enemy target will forget about your aggression. This effect is removed by melee or spell damage.

6.name: Silence
6.description: Silences your target, preventing them from spellcasting for 6 seconds.

7.name: Focused Concentration
7.description: Greatly sharpen your concentration, granting you a 100% chance to continue casting through incoming melee attacks for 15 seconds.

7.name: Holy Protection
7.description: Wards your target against the divine, increasing their Holy Resistance by 5 for 1 hour.

8.name: Dominate the Mind
8.description: Instantly charms your target, forcing them to fight for you for 1 minute.

8.name: Incinerate Mana
8.description: Burns 20 Mana from your target at the cost of 8.

8.name: Mind Enervation
8.description: Enervate your target, slowing their Casting Speed by 20% for 1 minute.

8.name: Sense Magic
8.description: Glaze the eyes of your target with a magical coating, granting them the ability to see magical effects when considering targets for 1 hour.

9.name: Dispel Magic
9.description: Dispel magic from your target, removing one harmful effect.

10.name: Aura of the Inquisitive
10.description: Envelop your group in an inquisitive aura, increasing their Mana Regeneration by 1 (L1) to 3 (L60).

10.name: Purifying Blow
10.description: Unleashes a purifying blow on your target, dealing 150% Weapon Damage plus 1 (L1) to 20 (L60) Magic Damage and 1 (L1) to 20 (L60) Physical Damage. Additionally if the target is afflicted by any spell in the Magic Break line, dispels one of your target's beneficial buffs. Chance to trigger again if the target is afflicted with Slam Stun.
10.valuesSummary: 150% weapon dmg · 1–20 Magic dmg (L1–L60) · 1–20 Physical dmg (L1–L60)

10.name: Scintillating Shock
10.description: Shocks nearby enemies with bright lights, stunning them for 4 seconds. This ability shares a cooldown with other abilities in the same line.

11.name: Invisibility
11.description: Shroud a target group member in a cloak of invisibility, rendering them unseen by the living for 10 minutes.

12.name: Haste
12.description: Haste your target, increasing their Melee and Ranged Attack Speed by 10% (L4) to 15% (L16) for 1h.

12.name: Mana Ward
12.description: Shield your target with a mana ward, absorbing 60 Spell Damage received for 15 seconds.

12.name: Memory Fog
12.description: Manipulate the mind of your target, giving a chance to forget past wrongdoings.

12.name: See Invisibility
12.description: Clear the eyes of your target with a magical coating, granting them the ability to see invisible entities for 1 hour.

14.name: Psychic Choke

15.name: Purge
15.description: Purge your target, removing one beneficial effect.

16.name: Minor Strength
16.description: Increases the Strength of a friendly target by 2 for 30 minutes.

17.name: Deflect
17.description: Deflect magical attacks, reducing incoming Magic Damage dealt to you by 40% for 30 seconds.
